_comment: The benchmark environment this commit expects (docs/adr/0018). manifest_sha256 is the pin (sha256 of the canonical environment manifest) of the full environment: the shared image container/benchmark.Dockerfile builds, plus the Win32 corpus's set added on each machine by container/licence.Dockerfile with Microsoft's licence accepted there. A benchmark run in any other environment gets its own run id (-env<hash>). shared_manifest_sha256 is the pin of the shared, licence-free image alone, and shared_image that image by digest; where it is pulled from is the deployment's business, not this file's. Update all three in the same commit as any change to the Dockerfiles, a dependency set or the manifest generator, after rebuilding: python -m bench container-run prints the pin.
